title: The British Museum: Report and Accounts 2023–24
author: British Museum

notes.text: Official annual report selected for A Short History of Taking Things and Keeping Them. Relevant locators: Missing, stolen and damaged items; Governance Statement discussion of collection security, records and the Independent Review. The report describes approximately 2,000 items as missing, stolen or damaged, not 2,000 proven thefts, and records weaknesses and planned corrective measures. It documents the institution's own account of care failures for that reporting period; it is not a current missing-item count. No individual object is identified for linking. The indexed official document was reviewed; direct PDF retrieval was unsuccessful. No complete-copy reuse terms have yet been verified, so no capture is registered.
